title: Semi-hyponormality of commuting pairs of Hilbert space operators
summary: We first find an explicit formula for the square root of positive $2 \times 2$ operator matrices with commuting entries, and then use it to define and study semi-hyponormality for commuting pairs of Hilbert space operators. \ For the well-known $3$--parameter family $W_{(α,β)}(a,x,y)$ of $2$--variable weighted shifts, we completely identify the parametric regions in the open unit cube where $W_{(α,β)}(a,x,y)$ is subnormal, hyponormal, semi-hyponormal, and weakly hyponormal.
